description: SolarPV-DER is Argonne National Laboratory's dynamic-phasor simulation of photovoltaic distributed energy resources connected to an electric grid. It includes single-phase, balanced three-phase and unbalanced three-phase inverters, with configurable volt-var control and voltage or frequency ride-through. Inputs are JSON device parameters and solar, grid-voltage or frequency events. Outputs include currents, voltages and active or reactive power at the point of common coupling. The run duration and simulation step follow the configuration, and the model represents a single distributed resource against a stiff grid source or externally supplied grid voltages. The Python package is free under the BSD-style three-clause terms in its own LICENSE. It can run alone or in a loop with another grid program. This single-device boundary is a limit for whole-feeder studies and does not replace a network power-flow model. The README names TDcoSim and Gym-DER as applications, but those integrations were not run here. The package is useful for distribution-grid stability and smart-inverter testing. OpenDSS (platform-opendss) offers related distribution-network simulation.
inputs: Solar irradiance and grid disturbance events
name: SolarPV-DER inverter dynamics model
